favorite.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for an existing Nintendo DS game's HD replacement renderer. Edit target is the attached transparent reference atlas. Redraw ALL EIGHT robots into clean high-resolution Japanese mecha anime cel art: crisp smooth ink contours, precise armor panel lines, controlled cel highlights/shadows, no pixels. This is a strict registration atlas, not a poster. Keep exactly the same 4-column by 2-row arrangement, each robot's bounding box, center, pose, facing, proportions, silhouette, colors and equipment. Top row: white blue feather-wing Gundam with red/yellow details; small red angular robot with long equipment; white/red armored Tekkaman; dark gray squat military robot with turquoise eye. Bottom row: orange green purple horned robot; lavender Mazinger with red chest; dark blue red gold heroic robot; large dark blue red white lion-faced combining robot with green accents. Preserve all 8 designs faithfully to the pixels, do not change horns, faces, limbs, wings or weapons. Preserve original transparent empty space between cells; draw no backgrounds, text, labels, grid or shadows. Each cell must remain separate at its exact original location. Render at the same 2048 by 896 layout or a precisely proportional canvas. Background genuinely transparent, including gaps inside wings and between limbs. Do not add objects, do not merge robots, do not crop. Source sprite alpha/silhouette will be used to register the final art.
favorite.cleanup_prompt: Edit target: image 1, the generated eight-robot sprite atlas. Supporting registration reference: image 2, original 4x2 atlas. Remove ALL smoky gray clouds, grain, speckled noise, colored halos, cast shadows, and background decoration surrounding each robot. Keep only the eight opaque clean cel-painted robots with genuine zero-alpha transparency everywhere else. There must be no glow or grunge within transparent gaps or around outlines. Preserve the existing robot art, armor lines, faces, colors, poses, and all relative positions. Preserve the same 4-column 2-row exact-layout atlas. If necessary slightly register the robot locations and sizes to the original reference, never rearrange. Smooth crisp anti-aliased contours, no pixelation. Absolutely no additional visuals in the transparent space. This is a production sprite texture, not concept art.

name_card.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Left slot contains Kazuma's smiling bust with brown spiky hair, blue eyes, cheek bandage on viewer right, orange pilot jacket and cream fleece collar, with torso cropped at the slot bottom/right. Right slot contains his long blue white red transforming fighter aircraft angled nose toward lower-left, wings toward upper-right. Redraw both as crisp clean high-resolution Japanese anime cel artwork, smooth controlled ink strokes and mechanical panel lines, fine hair strands, faithful native colors and facial identity. Preserve each silhouette, pose, face expression, perspective, exact bounding box and position relative to its own slot. Do not enlarge, center or move subjects; preserve the LARGE transparent empty left region of the left slot and empty lower region of the right slot exactly. Keep the TWO SLOTS SEPARATE; the portrait must NOT overlap the aircraft and no figure may cross the central 50% dividing boundary. Do not include a divider. Preserve native clipping at outer canvas edges. No text, backgrounds, grid, stars, clouds, glow, grunge, colored halos, cast shadows or decorations. Genuine clean zero-alpha transparency outside the opaque painted subjects, including aircraft gaps. Maintain the same 2048x768 canvas proportions. This atlas will be split back into independent game layers.
